title: Jensen's inequality for a concave function
statement:
Let $S \subseteq \bbr$ and let $g : \bbr \to \bbr$ be concave on $S$. Let $p = (p_1, \dots, p_n)$ be a mixed strategy over $n$ actions, that is, a tuple of weights $p_j \ge 0$ with $\sum_{j=1}^{n} p_j = 1$, and let $y_1, \dots, y_n$ be points of $S$. Then
\[
  \sum_{j=1}^{n} p_j\, g(y_j) \;\le\; g\!\left(\sum_{j=1}^{n} p_j\, y_j\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: p is a mixed strategy (weights nonnegative, summing to one)
replaced:
If $g$ is concave on $S \subseteq \bbr$, $p \in \Delta_n$, and every $y_j \in S$,
then
\[
  \sum_{j} p_j\, g(y_j)
  \;\leq\;
  g\!\left(\sum_{j} p_j\, y_j\right).
\]
